name: mp-agenda
description: MP Agenda — agendamento online para pequenos negócios

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mp-agenda/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @mp-agenda/api" "npm run dev -w @mp-agenda/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mp-agenda/shared && npm run build -w @mp-agenda/api && npm run build -w @mp-agenda/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mp-agenda/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mp-agenda/api && npm run typecheck -w @mp-agenda/web
